title: Introduce budget-nudge controller and quantization safety limiter
author: Noah Turner
description:
Motivation: We observe that some tenants experience sudden cost spikes when defaults for batching and quant profiles are too aggressive for their traffic shape. This PR introduces a lightweight 'budget-nudge' controller that applies soft, tenant-scoped adjustments to batching/caching defaults and a complementary 'quantization safety limiter' that prevents risky profile rollouts when unit-econ signals degrade. The goal is automated, reversible nudges (not hard overrides) with observability and an easy opt-out path.

What this PR does (summary): 1) Adds budget_nudge_controller service that monitors per-tenant unit-econ signals (cost per token, recent latency percentiles, warm-start hit rates) and computes conservative adjustments to: - target_batch_size - prefix_cache_ttl - microbatch_warmup_steps 2) Introduces quant_safety_limiter which blocks automated quantized-profile rollouts when the simulated delta in unit-econ or the loss-estimate exceeds configured thresholds; exposes a dry-run mode that outputs estimated token-cost delta and estimated p95 latency impact. 3) Provides a defaults-suggestion CLI (rwictl econ suggest) that emits a JSON patch of suggested defaults per tenant for review. 4) Ships telemetry hooks and alerts: new metrics, dashboards, and a Lightstep tracing span naming convention for nudge decisions. 5) Includes integration tests (simulated traffic replay) and a follow-up migration job to persist soft-nudges to the tenant defaults table.

Design notes and safety: - Nudges are conservative by default: we only shift parameters slowly (max +10% batch size per 24h, TTL adjustments capped) and always attach a confidence score. - Nudges can be auto-rolled back if cost increases > configured window or if latency regressions cross threshold. - Quant safety limiter runs a fast simulation path (sampled tokens + cached KV warmstart model) and refuses rollout if regression risk > 2% or if loss-estimate increases beyond guard rails. - All decisions are logged and surfaced in Console under the "Budget Nudges" section.

Checklist: - [x] Budget_nudge_controller implementation (Go) - [x] Quant_safety_limiter implementation (Python worker) - [x] rwictl econ suggest CLI and dry-run output - [x] Telemetry: metrics, traces, dashboard seed JSON - [x] Integration tests with synthetic traffic harness - [x] Docs: console UX and opt-out guide - [x] Add feature flag (feature.budget_nudge) with default off for new tenants

Related: ENG-3045 (tenant cost stability), ENG-3187 (unit-econ telemetry), SUP-1123 (customer incident that motivated soft rollbacks). See design doc: internal.redwood/notes/budget-nudge-controller (link internal only).

Commits (summary): - initial budget-nudge controller scaffold, metrics and config schema - add heuristic engine and rate limiter for parameter deltas - implement quant-safety worker + simulator endpoint - rwictl econ suggest CLI + JSON patch writer - add integration tests and fixtures - docs and dashboard seeds - minor test fixes and CI flakiness fixes

Files changed (high-level): - src/econ/budget_nudge_controller/controller.go (core controller loop, decision engine) - src/econ/budget_nudge_controller/heuristics.go (heuristic rules for batch/cache nudges) - src/econ/quant_safety/worker.py (simulation and gating logic) - src/cli/rwictl/econ/suggest.go (CLI dry-run and patch exporter) - infra/telemetry/dashboards/budget_nudge_dashboard.json - tests/integration/econ/replay_nudge_test.py - migrations/2026_02_15_persist_nudges.sql - docs/console/budget_nudges.md - docs/operational/quant_safety.md - helm/values.yaml (feature flag defaults)

Small illustrative diff (controller loop sketch): "for tenant in enabledTenants { metrics := fetchUnitEcon(tenant); suggestion := heuristics.Suggest(metrics); if suggestion.Confidence > cfg.MinConfidence && withinRateLimit(tenant) { persistSoftNudge(tenant, suggestion); emitTrace(span, suggestion) } }"

Operational notes: - Feature gated under feature.budget_nudge; rollout plan: start with 10 pilot tenants, observe 48h windows, then progressive ramp to 30% of tenants. - Alerts created: BudgetNudge::RollbackNeeded, QuantSafety::BlockingRollout (SLO: <5 noisy alerts per week during ramp). - Migration persists soft nudges as JSON blob in tenant_defaults.nudges (reversible).

Testing: - Unit tests for heuristic thresholds and rollback logic included. - Integration replay harness simulates ten tenant shapes (burst, long-tail, interactive) and validates no >5% cost increase regressions under nudges. - Quant safety simulations include golden baseline and random seed to detect flakiness.

Backward compatibility and opt-out: Nudges are stored as separate metadata and do not replace explicit tenant overrides. Admins can disable auto-nudges per tenant from Console or via API.
